title: Deepfake Audit: Digital Composite / Partial Manipulation
claim: Forensic analysis identifies a hybrid image where real human subjects have been combined with a digitally rendered or AI-generated character. The background and primary subjects exhibit natural sensor noise, but the central character displays inconsistent edge sharpness and lighting geometry.
summary: Forensic analysis identifies a hybrid image where real human subjects have been combined with a digitally rendered or AI-generated character. The background and primary subjects exhibit natural sensor noise, but the central character displays inconsistent edge sharpness and lighting geometry.
evidence: Inconsistent lighting on the Spider-Man mask compared to the human subjects
Lack of contact shadows where the gloved hand meets the shoulder
Discrepancy in focal depth between the character and the immediate foreground
Sharp edge boundaries around the inserted character suggesting a mask/cutout
